verses.en: Unto thee will I cry, O LORD my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.
verses.pt: A ti, SENHOR, rocha minha, eu clamo; não te silencies para comigo; para que não aconteça de, se tu calares quanto a mim, eu não me torne semelhante aos que descem à cova.
verses.en_web: To you, Yahweh, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me; lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go down into the pit.
verses.en_bbe: <Of David.> My cry goes up to you, O Lord, my Rock; do not keep back your answer from me, so that I may not become like those who go down into the underworld.

verses.en: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, when I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.
verses.pt: Ouve a voz de minhas súplicas, quando eu clamar a ti, ao levantar às minhas mãos ao templo de tua santidade.
verses.en_web: Hear the voice of my petitions, when I cry to you, when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.
verses.en_bbe: Give ear to the voice of my prayer, when I am crying to you, when my hands are lifted up to your holy place.

verses.en: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief is in their hearts.
verses.pt: Não me jogues fora com os perversos, nem com os praticantes da maldade, que falam de paz com sem próximo, porém há o mal no coração deles.
verses.en_web: Don’t draw me away with the wicked, with the workers of iniquity who speak peace with their neighbors, but mischief is in their hearts.
verses.en_bbe: Do not take me away with the sinners and the workers of evil, who say words of peace to their neighbours, but evil is in their hearts.

verses.en: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.
verses.pt: Dá-lhes conforme as obras deles, e conforme a maldade de seus atos; dá-lhes conforme a obra das mãos deles, retribui-lhes como eles merecem.
verses.en_web: Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings. Give them according to the operation of their hands. Bring back on them what they deserve.
verses.en_bbe: Give them the right reward of their acts, and of their evil doings: give them punishment for the works of their hands, let them have their full reward.

verses.en: Because they regard not the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.
verses.pt: Porque eles não dão atenção para os atos do SENHOR, nem para a obra de suas mãos; então ele os derrubará e não os edificará.
verses.en_web: Because they don’t respect the works of Yahweh, nor the operation of his hands, he will break them down and not build them up.
verses.en_bbe: Because they have no respect for the works of the Lord, or for the things which his hands have made, they will be broken down and not lifted up by him.

verses.en: Blessed be the LORD, because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.
verses.pt: Bendito seja o SENHOR, porque ele ouviu a voz de minhas súplicas.
verses.en_web: Blessed be Yahweh, because he has heard the voice of my petitions.
verses.en_bbe: May the Lord be praised, because he has given ear to the voice of my prayer.

verses.en: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.
verses.pt: O SENHOR é a minha força e meu escudo; meu coração confiou nele, e foi socorrido; por isso meu coração salta de alegria; e com meu canto eu o louvarei.
verses.en_web: Yahweh is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord is my strength and my breastplate, my heart had faith in him and I am helped; for this cause my heart is full of rapture, and I will give him praise in my song.

verses.en: The LORD is their strength, and he is the saving strength of his anointed.
verses.pt: O SENHOR é a força deles, e o poder das salvações de seu Ungido.
verses.en_web: Yahweh is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord is their strength, and a strong place of salvation for his king.

verses.en: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.
verses.pt: Salva a teu povo, e abençoa a tua herança; e apascenta-os, e levanta-os para sempre. Salmo de Davi:
verses.en_web: Save your people, and bless your inheritance. Be their shepherd also, and bear them up forever.
verses.en_bbe: Be a saviour to your people, and send a blessing on your heritage: be their guide, and let them be lifted up for ever.
